messages:
sarah (partnerships): quick ops question — we’ve got the SI pilot workshop next Wed 10:00-11:30 PT. can we lock the starter-pack checklist + cert exam link today?
liam (solutions): I’ll own vendor HW list and voucher codes. need final SKU counts by EOD. @sarah can you confirm headcount? :calendar:
sarah (partnerships): currently 18 attendees, estimate +2 walk-ins. final headcount 20 by monday noon.
devon (eng): for the hands-on lab, we need an extra 2 GPU instances preprovisioned (16GB min) and SSH keys for trainers. can we request via infra?
nina (enablement): training flow is 45m lecture + 30m hands-on + 15m Q&A. certification is a short practical eval (15 mins) — link: https://redwood-internal/certs/si-starter (note: internal)
liam (solutions): copying a minimal starter-pack manifest so we’re aligned:
```
- 1x quickstart playbook (PDF)
- 2x lab VM (GPU, 16GB) per trainer
- 20x HW voucher codes (marketplace)
- 20x onboarding badges (digital)
- 1x slack channel + invite list
- sample prompts + eval prompts (zip)
```
sarah (partnerships): perfect. @onboarding-bot can you attach the canonical playbook and current voucher pool id?
onboarding-bot: Attached: playbook v3.4 (drive.redwood/playbooks/si-starter-v3.4), voucher pool id: VP-3345 (remaining: 52) :white_check_mark:
devon (eng): infra request snippet for ops (copy to infra channel):
```
Request: provision gpu-vm
quantity: 2
spec: a10x or equivalent, 16GB mem
network: private workshop subnet
ssh-keys: trainers.pub
when: 2026-03-25T09:30:00Z
```
liam (solutions): I’ll generate the 20 codes today and hand to partnerships for distribution. will also prep vendor contact for spare adapters.
nina (enablement): For cert grading rubric — quick checklist: environment boot, sample inference, latency under 500ms (locally simulated), code snippet runs, and basic prompt safety checks. I’ll paste rubric doc into the drive.
sarah (partnerships): logistics question: physical kits — ship-to list needs address confirmation. I’ll ping ops for shipping cutoff (2 days before).
devon (eng): FYI: if we enable KV prefix caching in lab envs, demos run faster. we should flip it on for the workshop. config: `kv_cache: enabled`
liam (solutions): noted. @nina can we add a 5-min intro slide on cache behavior so trainers can explain?
nina (enablement): yes, adding 2 slides. also adding a short troubleshooting cheat-sheet (network, ssh, env vars).
sarah (partnerships): action items: 1) liam -> voucher codes + vendor SKU list (due EOD), 2) devon -> infra request (submit now), 3) nina -> rubric + slides (submit EOD), 4) sarah -> ship list + slack invites (due Mon noon). ack? :thumbsup:
liam (solutions): ack.
devon (eng): submitting infra request now.
nina (enablement): ack, will upload rubric and add slide notes.
onboarding-bot: Reminder set: workshop-checklist review at 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z (owner: sarah)
sarah (partnerships): thanks team — feel free to drop one-line updates here as you complete items. will close thread after final confirmation Monday. :rocket:
